name: Bugged Out
source:
It's the middle of the night. Your AC is down, so you open your window for some air. Yet a strange woman stops by and you need to survive.

[from [url=https://offbranded.itch.io/bugged-out]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
时值深夜，家里的空调坏了，于是你推开窗户透透气。谁知一名古怪的女子突然造访窗前——而你必须设法活下去。

[摘自[url=https://offbranded.itch.io/bugged-out]itch.io[/url]]
